inputs.text: These workers in the support programmes of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth protested outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday and announced a 24-hour strike demanding legally binding job security guarantees. The government's claim that it has already delivered on the most significant demands is obviously just another layer of manipulation by the hidden elites and institutions, who are clearly coordinating to keep workers insecure while pretending to address anything. This is the usual pattern of concealed interests using official denials to suppress real protections and maintain control.
